symbols.name: forall
symbols.semantics: Universal typed quantification, declarations ordered with no shadowing.

symbols.name: exists
symbols.semantics: Existential typed quantification, declarations ordered with no shadowing.

symbols.name: type
symbols.semantics: Dependent type annotation of the bound variable.

symbols.name: Nat
symbols.semantics: Natural number including zero; dimensions and regularity orders are not interchangeable with real numbers.

symbols.name: Real
symbols.semantics: Real number ℝ.

symbols.name: RealFunction
symbols.semantics: Function ℝ → ℝ.

symbols.name: Index
symbols.semantics: Index(n) is Fin n. An index can exist only if n is positive.

symbols.name: Vector
symbols.semantics: Vector(n) is Fin n → ℝ with its standard finite product (supremum) norm.

symbols.name: Function
symbols.semantics: Function(m,n) is (Fin m → ℝ) → (Fin n → ℝ).

symbols.name: CLM
symbols.semantics: CLM(m,n) is (Fin m → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ).

symbols.name: Matrix
symbols.semantics: Matrix(m,n) is Matrix (Fin m) (Fin n) ℝ; row dimension first, column dimension second.

symbols.name: ScalarFunction
symbols.semantics: ScalarFunction(n) is (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ.

symbols.name: ScalarCLM
symbols.semantics: ScalarCLM(n) is (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ.

symbols.name: Bilinear
symbols.semantics: Bilinear(n) is (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ.

symbols.name: ScalarDerivativeField
symbols.semantics: ScalarDerivativeField(n) is (Fin n → ℝ) → ((Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).

symbols.name: DerivativeField
symbols.semantics: DerivativeField(m,n) is (Fin m → ℝ) → ((Fin m → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ)).

symbols.name: Set
symbols.semantics: Set(n) is Set (Fin n → ℝ).

symbols.name: Curve
symbols.semantics: Curve(n) is ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ).

symbols.name: FunctionFamily
symbols.semantics: FunctionFamily(k,n) is Fin k → ((Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ).

symbols.name: DualFamily
symbols.semantics: DualFamily(k,n) is Fin k → ((Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).

symbols.name: RealFunctionFamily
symbols.semantics: RealFunctionFamily(n) is Fin n → (ℝ → ℝ).

symbols.name: ProductScalarFunction
symbols.semantics: ProductScalarFunction(m,n) is ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) → ℝ.

symbols.name: ProductFunction
symbols.semantics: ProductFunction(m,n,p) is ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) → (Fin p → ℝ).

symbols.name: ProductCLM
symbols.semantics: ProductCLM(m,n,p) is ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] (Fin p → ℝ).

symbols.name: LeftField
symbols.semantics: LeftField(m,n,p) is ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) → ((Fin m → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin p → ℝ)).

symbols.name: RightField
symbols.semantics: RightField(m,n,p) is ((Fin m → ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) → ((Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin p → ℝ)).

symbols.name: real_nat
symbols.semantics: Cast a natural number into ℝ; no implicit real literals.

symbols.name: real_add
symbols.semantics: Real addition, first plus second.

symbols.name: real_sub
symbols.semantics: Real subtraction, first minus second.

symbols.name: real_mul
symbols.semantics: Real multiplication.

symbols.name: apply
symbols.semantics: apply(m,n,f,x)=f x.

symbols.name: scalar_apply
symbols.semantics: scalar_apply(n,f,x)=f x.

symbols.name: coordinate
symbols.semantics: coordinate(n,x,i)=x i.

symbols.name: basis_vector
symbols.semantics: basis_vector(n,i)=Pi.single i 1.

symbols.name: zero
symbols.semantics: Zero vector in Fin n → ℝ.

symbols.name: add
symbols.semantics: Vector addition in the stated dimension.

symbols.name: projection
symbols.semantics: projection(n,i)=fun x => x i.

symbols.name: projection_clm
symbols.semantics: ContinuousLinearMap.proj i.

symbols.name: update_curve
symbols.semantics: update_curve(n,x,i)=fun t => Function.update x i t.

symbols.name: coordinate_slice
symbols.semantics: coordinate_slice(n,f,x,i)=fun t => f (Function.update x i t). The scalar parameter is the coordinate value, not an increment.

symbols.name: component
symbols.semantics: component(m,n,f,j)=fun x => f x j.

symbols.name: component_clm
symbols.semantics: component_clm(m,n,A,j)=(ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).comp A.

symbols.name: has_fderiv
symbols.semantics: has_fderiv(m,n,f,x,A)=HasFDerivAt f A x. Point precedes derivative.

symbols.name: has_scalar_fderiv
symbols.semantics: has_scalar_fderiv(n,f,x,A)=HasFDerivAt f A x. Point precedes derivative.

symbols.name: has_scalar_strict_fderiv
symbols.semantics: HasStrictFDerivAt f A x with ordered arguments n,f,x,A. Strict differentiability is stronger than differentiability at one point.

symbols.name: differentiable_at
symbols.semantics: DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.

symbols.name: scalar_differentiable_at
symbols.semantics: DifferentiableAt ℝ f x.

symbols.name: scalar_differentiable
symbols.semantics: Differentiable ℝ f on the entire coordinate space.

symbols.name: has_deriv
symbols.semantics: has_deriv(f,t,v)=HasDerivAt f v t; evaluation point then derivative value.

symbols.name: has_curve_deriv
symbols.semantics: has_curve_deriv(n,c,t,v)=HasDerivAt c v t.

symbols.name: clm_apply
symbols.semantics: Application A v.

symbols.name: dual_apply
symbols.semantics: Application A v.

symbols.name: dual_zero
symbols.semantics: Zero continuous linear functional.

symbols.name: dual_add
symbols.semantics: Sum of continuous linear functionals.

symbols.name: dual_scale
symbols.semantics: Scalar c • A; arguments n,c,A.

symbols.name: compose
symbols.semantics: compose(m,n,p,g,f)=g ∘ f, applying f first.

symbols.name: jacobian
symbols.semantics: jacobian(m,n,f,x)=LinearMap.toMatrix' (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap. Row is output coordinate, column input coordinate. fderiv is totalized, so using this operator alone does not assert differentiability.

symbols.name: matrix_entry
symbols.semantics: Entry A row column, in that order.

symbols.name: matrix_mul
symbols.semantics: Matrix product A B, in output-to-input order.

symbols.name: matrix_action
symbols.semantics: Matrix.mulVec A v.

symbols.name: linearization_remainder
symbols.semantics: fun y => f y - f x - (LinearMap.toMatrix' (fderiv ℝ f x).toLinearMap).mulVec (y-x).

symbols.name: little_o_displacement
symbols.semantics: little_o_displacement(m,n,r,x) means r =o[nhds x] (fun y => y-x). This is the full vector first-order remainder relation, not pointwise equality.

symbols.name: scalar_cont_diff
symbols.semantics: scalar_cont_diff(n,k,f)=ContDiff ℝ k f for natural k, including zero.

symbols.name: field_cont_diff
symbols.semantics: ContDiff ℝ k D as a function into the operator-normed space of linear functionals.

symbols.name: scalar_fderiv_field
symbols.semantics: The function fderiv ℝ f; totalized as zero at nondifferentiable points.

symbols.name: bilinear_apply
symbols.semantics: B u v, with u the outer and v the inner slot.

symbols.name: quadratic
symbols.semantics: quadratic(n,B)=fun x => B x x; B need not be symmetric.

symbols.name: quadratic_derivative
symbols.semantics: B x + B.flip x, the functional h ↦ B x h + B h x.

symbols.name: quadratic_field
symbols.semantics: fun x => B x + B.flip x.

symbols.name: symmetrize
symbols.semantics: B + B.flip, not their half; evaluates to B u v + B v u.

symbols.name: has_field_derivative
symbols.semantics: HasFDerivAt D H x, arguments n,D,x,H.

symbols.name: product_slice_left
symbols.semantics: fun x => f (x,y); fix the right variable.

symbols.name: product_slice_right
symbols.semantics: fun y => f (x,y); fix the left variable.

symbols.name: left_field_apply
symbols.semantics: A (x,y).

symbols.name: right_field_apply
symbols.semantics: B (x,y).

symbols.name: continuous_left_field_at
symbols.semantics: ContinuousAt A (x,y), joint continuity in both blocks.

symbols.name: continuous_right_field_at
symbols.semantics: ContinuousAt B (x,y), joint continuity in both blocks.

symbols.name: coprod
symbols.semantics: A.coprod B, mapping (u,v) to A u + B v.

symbols.name: has_product_strict_fderiv
symbols.semantics: HasStrictFDerivAt f C (x,y); points x,y precede derivative C.

symbols.name: local_extr_fiber
symbols.semantics: local_extr_fiber(n,objective,constraint,x)=IsLocalExtrOn objective {y | constraint y = constraint x} x.

symbols.name: family_at
symbols.semantics: The ith scalar constraint function.

symbols.name: dual_family_at
symbols.semantics: The ith constraint derivative functional.

symbols.name: local_extr_fibers
symbols.semantics: local_extr_fibers(k,n,objective,F,x)=IsLocalExtrOn objective {y | ∀ i, F i y = F i x} x.

symbols.name: weighted_dual_sum
symbols.semantics: ∑ i : Fin k, coefficients i • derivativeFamily i.

symbols.name: product_scalar_slice_left
symbols.semantics: fun x => f (x,y).

symbols.name: product_scalar_slice_right
symbols.semantics: fun y => f (x,y).

symbols.name: axis_jump
symbols.semantics: axis_jump(m,n,i,j,a)=fun (x,y) => if x i = 0 ∨ y j = 0 then 0 else a. This explicit discontinuous family has no implicit regularity assumption.

symbols.name: product_continuous_at
symbols.semantics: ContinuousAt f (x,y).

symbols.name: integrable
symbols.semantics: MeasureTheory.Integrable f with respect to Lebesgue volume on Fin n → ℝ; requires absolute integrability for real functions.

symbols.name: integral
symbols.semantics: Bochner integral ∫ x, f x with respect to Lebesgue volume. Lean totalizes nonintegrable integrals to zero; existence must be asserted separately.

symbols.name: product_integrable
symbols.semantics: Integrable f with respect to the product of the two Lebesgue volume measures.

symbols.name: product_integral
symbols.semantics: ∫ z, f z with respect to product Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: product_separable
symbols.semantics: fun (x,y) => f x * g y.

symbols.name: inner_integral_right
symbols.semantics: fun x => ∫ y, f (x,y); integrate the right variable first.

symbols.name: inner_integral_left
symbols.semantics: fun y => ∫ x, f (x,y); integrate the left variable first.

symbols.name: ae_right_sections_integrable
symbols.semantics: ∀ᵐ x with respect to left Lebesgue volume, Integrable (fun y => f (x,y)). This is almost everywhere, never every section.

symbols.name: product_ae_strongly_measurable
symbols.semantics: AEStronglyMeasurable f for product Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: inner_abs_integral
symbols.semantics: fun x => ∫ y, ‖f (x,y)‖; real norm is absolute value.

symbols.name: product_integrable_on
symbols.semantics: IntegrableOn f (s ×ˢ t) for product Lebesgue volume; s,t need not be assumed measurable in this Fubini identity.

symbols.name: product_set_integral
symbols.semantics: ∫ z in s ×ˢ t, f z for product Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: inner_set_integral_right
symbols.semantics: fun x => ∫ y in t, f (x,y).

symbols.name: set_integral
symbols.semantics: ∫ x in s, f x with respect to restricted Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: real_family_at
symbols.semantics: f i : ℝ → ℝ.

symbols.name: real_integrable
symbols.semantics: Integrable f with respect to Lebesgue volume on ℝ.

symbols.name: separable_n_product
symbols.semantics: fun x : Fin n → ℝ => ∏ i, f i (x i). n may be zero.

symbols.name: product_real_integrals
symbols.semantics: ∏ i : Fin n, ∫ t : ℝ, f i t, with empty product 1.

symbols.name: measurable_set
symbols.semantics: MeasurableSet s in the Borel measurable space of the coordinate space.

symbols.name: injective_on
symbols.semantics: Set.InjOn f s, no global injectivity inferred.

symbols.name: image
symbols.semantics: Set.image f s.

symbols.name: field_apply
symbols.semantics: D x.

symbols.name: member
symbols.semantics: x ∈ s.

symbols.name: has_fderiv_within
symbols.semantics: HasFDerivWithinAt f A s x, arguments n,f,x,s,A. No open set or nonzero Jacobian is assumed implicitly.

symbols.name: jacobian_weighted
symbols.semantics: fun x => |(D x).det| * g (f x), with absolute determinant and derivative field D.

symbols.name: integrable_on
symbols.semantics: IntegrableOn g s for Lebesgue volume.

symbols.name: curve_apply
symbols.semantics: c t.

symbols.name: scalar_field_apply
symbols.semantics: D x.

symbols.name: pullback_one_form
symbols.semantics: pullback_one_form(n,D,c,v)=fun t => D (c t) (v t). v is separately required to be the actual curve derivative.

symbols.name: interval_integrable
symbols.semantics: IntervalIntegrable f volume a b; both orientations and a=b allowed.

symbols.name: interval_integral
symbols.semantics: ∫ t in a..b, f t, the oriented interval integral.

symbols.name: in_uIcc
symbols.semantics: in_uIcc(t,a,b) means t ∈ Set.uIcc a b.

symbols.name: and
symbols.semantics: Standard logic1.and; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: or
symbols.semantics: Standard logic1.or; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: implies
symbols.semantics: Standard logic1.implies; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: not
symbols.semantics: Standard logic1.not; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: equivalent
symbols.semantics: Standard logic1.equivalent; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: eq
symbols.semantics: Standard relation1.eq; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: neq
symbols.semantics: Standard relation1.neq; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: leq
symbols.semantics: Standard relation1.leq; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: lt
symbols.semantics: Standard relation1.lt; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.

symbols.name: plus
symbols.semantics: Standard arith1.plus; matching sorts required, propositional arguments for logic and numeric arguments for ordering/arithmetic.
